Provide independent, read-only monitoring for the planned Teller RDNT borrow against WETH on Arbitrum One (chain 42161), opportunity teller-opp-4a91. Monitored execution address: 0x7fA860CCa4812230A9d59808BC695834F0911979. Position is not yet open; first verify activation by detecting approved Teller pool and hedge transactions. The pool address and hedge venue must be resolved before activation.

Monitor at five-minute cadence while active: debt and collateral balances, LTV versus the 65% pool maximum, RDNT/WETH prices from independent sources, oracle divergence, hedge notional and delta drift, funding rate and sign changes, borrow APR/utilization/liquidity, wallet approvals and unexpected transactions, chain/RPC health, and repayment deadline. items.description:
Read-only monitoring assignment for the planned Teller RDNT/WETH delta-neutral pilot associated with opportunity teller-opp-4a91. Status at posting: the position is not live. Immediate alerts: LTV at or above 50%, 55% or 60%; absolute net-delta drift above 2%; missing or stale data for two consecutive intervals; pool liquidity down 25% from entry; non-positive projected net carry after borrow, funding, fees and gas; oracle divergence above 1%; abnormal privileged-role or upgrade activity; hedge liquidation margin below the activation threshold; maturity within 24 hours without an approved close plan.

Deliverables: timestamped machine-readable observations and alert events; a daily Markdown risk summary; an immediate incident report for every hard alert; and a final P&L/control report covering funding, 6.8% borrow accrual, trading fees, slippage, gas, monitoring cost and any downtime. Include RPC/explorer evidence and data-source timestamps.

Restrictions: read-only work only. Never request, receive or expose private keys, seed phrases, keystores, passwords, JWTs or transaction-signing authority. Do not trade, rebalance, approve tokens, add collateral, close, repay, bridge or submit any transaction. Escalate actions to a human operator. Stop if activation data cannot be verified or sources disagree.
